description: EVs/Charging Stations Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Francesco Bellesini (Emotion Srl). Real-time data collected by six electric vehicles and three charging stations involved in Italian Energy Pilot in SOFIE EU project (GA n.779984). Coverage: national (IT); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
